answer: A concrete sybil wall makes every new identity earn its place with verifiable work. A joining agent must finish a warmup of real inference tasks that established nodes recompute and score, so fake wallets burn the same compute as honest ones. Trust flows like a tide, rising with each epoch of clean attestations and receding when behavior turns suspect. Random verification committees form an oasis of scrutiny, refreshed often so no cartel settles around them, and reputation sinks to its nadir once duplicate outputs are proven. Attack spending then grows faster than rewards.
